items.title: Cisco Firewall Management Center Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
items.product: Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
items.description: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.

priority.reason: Confirmed exploited (CISA KEV). EPSS 75% probability of exploitation within 30 days. CVSS v3 base score 10.0.

w5h.what_impacted: Systems running Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
w5h.technology: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
w5h.upgrade_action: Apply current vendor patches for Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management per the advisory (CISA remediation due date: 2026-09-12)
w5h.why_it_matters: This matters because exploitation is confirmed or actively occurring, not theoretical; EPSS puts exploitation probability at 75% within 30 days; critical severity means full compromise is likely if reached; edge/network devices are internet-facing and a top initial-access vector.

impact.affected_versions: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management (specific versions not provided, assume all vulnerable until vendor clarifies)
impact.how_to_check: Identify all internet-facing Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management devices. Check firmware versions against the advisory, and review access logs for unauthorized access, unusual processes, or configuration changes.
